$description: Fynona brand A «Повітря» design tokens, extracted from the approved prototype r2 (the approved prototype r2, kept outside the repository). Format: Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10. Money never appears here (DOM-11).

app.fynona.source: the approved prototype r2, kept outside the repository
app.fynona.note: Values are the prototype's except where a lead decision of 2026-11-26 changed them (docs/design/README.md#decisions): contrast fixes F1-F29 (D1), 48 dp touch targets (D2), rows stack from text scale 1.3 (D3), bundled Inter (D4), profile colours separate from the chart palette (D6), opaque-leaning sheet tint (D7). Every changed token keeps the prototype value in $extensions.app.fynona.prototype; new roles carry $extensions.app.fynona.newRole.

glass.$description: Glass is painted only on chrome: top header, bottom nav, rail/sidebar, sheets, toast, floating selection bar, FAB (CLI-31). Never on list rows. Modes (CLI-32, ADR-002): blur = BackdropFilter(blur σ, saturate) + tint; prebaked = pre-blurred background art (same σ and saturation, rendered once) + the same tint, no BackdropFilter; opaque = surface.chrome, no highlight (manual «Без скла»); highContrast = opaque + 1.5 px outline. Auto mode drops from blur to prebaked when the frame detector trips.

blurSigma.$description: Gaussian standard deviation of the backdrop blur (CSS blur(28px) = σ 28; Flutter ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 28, sigmaY: 28)).

saturation.$description: Backdrop saturation multiplier applied before the tint (CSS saturate(190%); ADR-002 colour matrix).

prebakedTintLight.$description: Prebaked mode keeps the blur tint; the backdrop is the pre-blurred background art, so content under the chrome is hidden, not blurred.

edgeWidth.$description: Chrome edge line (border-bottom of headers, border-top of the nav), colour border.glass.

base.$description: The one UI family on every platform, bundled with the app (decision D4): iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and Flutter web, including the offline web build (no CDN, no runtime font fetch). Inter, SIL Open Font License 1.1, Cyrillic and Latin, variable weight axis (wght 100-900, so font.weight.heading 620 and strong 650 are exact). Headings, hero and wordmark use the same family. Font file not added yet: M1 adds it to fynona_ui assets with its OFL.txt. The fallback is only for the moment before the bundled font loads.
